// Shadowing and scoping cases for the symbol table (E07-03).
function pay(amount) {
  if (amount > limit) { var fee = 1; }
  return fee;
}
let limit = 10;

function shadows() {
  var x = 1;
  { let x = 2; use(x); }
  try { risky(); } catch (x) { log(x); }
  return x;
}

const make = (a) => (b) => a + b + limit;

class Account {
  balance = 0;
  deposit(amount) { this.balance += amount; return balance; }
  static open(initial) { const acct = new Account(); acct.balance = initial; return acct; }
}

const Named = class Inner { again() { return new Inner(); } };

function patterns(source) {
  const { first, second: renamed = 1, ...others } = source;
  let a, b;
  [a, b] = [renamed, first];
  return { a, b, others, first: a };
}

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { use(i); }
for (const key in limitMap) { use(key); }

function dynamic(obj, key) { return obj[key] + eval("1") + globalThis.setting; }

run();
function run() { return helperLater(); function helperLater() { return 1; } }
